title: Thermocol in the jeans
situation: Survival guides spread: thermocol sheets inside clothing against lathis, antacid-water for tear gas, swimming goggles, two helmets so you can lend one, a spare kurta, offline maps and Bluetooth messaging for internet shutdowns.

lines.text: Even a small gap lets the gas in.
lines.speaker: Hardik, 22

buildThis.situation: Nikhil turns up with thermocol under his shirt that squeaks when he walks; the player can strip it for a placard or let it save him at the charge.

sources.note: Title: "Jantar Mantar Protest: जींस में थर्मोकोल शीट का कमाल! Gen Z के viral Survival Tips!"
